title: Platform Status
meta_description: Public status page for managed platforms (Nexus, Forge, Swarm, Sentinel, Twinverse) with incident history.

blocks.x: Operational status for the managed Achala platforms, what we publish here, how incidents are communicated, and where tenant-specific telemetry lives.

Public availability for the managed surfaces of EEMS Platform, Forge, Swarm, Sentinel, Twinverse, Quanta, Ledger and Compass when they are consumed as Achala-operated services. Customer-tenanted deployments are monitored inside each tenant's own observability stack; their status lives with your platform team, not here.

Current state per platform, active incident summaries with impact and workaround, and scheduled maintenance windows announced at least five business days ahead. Historical availability per platform per quarter is available to affected clients on request through the delivery lead.

When an incident opens, this page is updated within fifteen minutes of confirmation, then at least hourly until resolved; the resolution note states cause, remediation and any follow-up work. Clients on managed platforms also receive direct notifications through the channels agreed in their service terms.

We grade incidents by user impact, not by how embarrassing they are: degraded performance counts, silent degradation is treated as an incident once detected, and post-incident reviews are shared with affected clients under the same severity grading.
